clue.text: Attempt an overdue repair

clue.text: Cameron brought about conclusion of debate to avoid answering

the last letter of the word

clue.text: Passing on by mouth something which is very dangerous

taken as written, then turned round

clue.text: Ahead is where patients are treated

the two middle letters of the eight-letter word
